scope: Foundation OpenFOAM 10, non-subcycled one-physical-window dynamic-mesh rollback

derived_reconstructed.meshPhi: created by fvMesh::movePoints; after rollback it is valid if the next same-input trial reproduces U/p/force/mesh and does not inherit trial-1 flux
derived_reconstructed.pointDisplacement: adapter face-to-point interpolation of restored cellDisplacement and the next received total displacement; equivalence is established at the next solve input
derived_reconstructed.oldPoints: recreated by OF10 movePoints on the next physical time layer; equivalence is established by next-trial mesh and fluid identity
derived_reconstructed.U/Uf oldTime created after a zero-histor: natural lazy OF10 history; equivalence requires same-input next-trial identity and no different-input contamination

frozen_numeric_identity: canonical diagnostic fingerprints for persistent fields; exact output-file SHA256 for OFF/ON; same-input replay uses canonical field/mesh/force equality at the same physical time
